integrity.claim_scope: Complete global classification, no-cycle theorem, and sharp critical extinction constants for the stated model only.
integrity.computational_checks: Symbolic identities and exact-rational finite checks plus explicitly illustrative numerical trajectories; analytic proof supplies infinite claims.

scientific_limitations: Deterministic autonomous two-population ODE; no inference about time delays, stochastic models, spatial diffusion or alternative functional responses.
Globally valid asymptotics require positive initial densities and parameters within the theorem; the critical 1/t limits are specific to invasion equality.
Novelty is literature-checked rather than externally certified, with a residual possibility of subsumption by an unindexed general planar theorem.
title: A sharp global predator–prey threshold and universal critical extinction law under fear and refuge
